summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Principal Value ETF (PY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund utilizes a proprietary quantitative model to actively invest in large- and mid-cap companies that exhibit higher degrees of shareholder yield. PY was launched on Mar 21, 2016 and is issued by Principal.

holdings.infoBox: PY is an equity ETF with a total of 101 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 9.33%, Amazon.com at 3.33%, Bank of America at 1.96%, The Procter & Gamble Company at 1.93%, and UnitedHealth Group at 1.90%.
